title: Implement --no-questions flag: skip clarification loop
description: When --no-questions is passed to rocket feature, skip the FeatureWizard TUI entirely. Call specGenerator directly with an empty Q&A array. The rest of the flow (preview, confirm, apply) remains unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket feature 'test feature' --no-questions runs without showing clarification questions
Spec and tasks are generated with empty Q&A

steps.details: In src/commands/feature.ts: if (options.questions === false) { // skip wizard; directly call generateSpec with empty qa array const result = await generateSpec({ prdContent, featureDescription: description, qa: [] }, backend) }
After generateSpec returns, proceed to FeatureDiffPreview regardless of whether questions were asked. The preview and confirmation flow is the same either way.
